local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
-- Resolve only after startup has either finished the cinematic or safely failed.
player:SetAttribute("IntroReady",false)
local Intro
task.spawn(function()
 local ok,err=xpcall(function()
  Intro=require(RS:WaitForChild("SnowIntroController"))
  local char=player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
  if not char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",15) then return end
  local deadline=os.clock()+5
  repeat task.wait(.1) until player:HasAppearanceLoaded() or os.clock()>deadline
  player:WaitForChild("leaderstats",10)
  task.wait(.35)
  if player.Character==char then Intro.Play() end
 end,debug.traceback)
 player:SetAttribute("IntroReady",true)
 if not ok then warn("[SnowIntro startup] "..tostring(err)) end
end)
-- Studio convenience: I replays the intro without resetting progress.
if RunService:IsStudio() then
 game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
  if not processed and input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.I and Intro and player:GetAttribute("IntroReady") and not player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then
   task.spawn(Intro.Play,{Preview=true})
  end
 end)
end

-- TutorialClient: first-time tutorial (white text on a smooth dark box + gliding arrows).
-- Starts once per player after the intro. Set the player attribute "IntroPlaying" = true while an intro plays.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local setSetting = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SetSetting")
local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local rngGui = pg:WaitForChild("RNGGui")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- UI
--------------------------------------------------
local sg = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = "Tutorial", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 45, IgnoreGuiInset = true, Enabled = false,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling}, pg)

-- message box
local box = mk("Frame", {Name = "Box", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.15), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
	AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, ZIndex = 5}, sg)
mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)}, box)
mk("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 26), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 26), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 14), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14)}, box)
local boxScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, box)
local label = mk("TextLabel", {Name = "Text", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
	Font = FONT, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextSize = 28, Text = "", RichText = true, ZIndex = 6}, box)
local skip = mk("TextButton", {Name = "Skip", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 30),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, Font = FONT, TextSize = 18, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
	Text = "Skip", ZIndex = 6}, box)
mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, skip)

-- scale text with the screen
local function fitText()
	label.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.032), 18, 34)
end
fitText()
camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fitText)

-- smooth arrow (rounded shaft + chevron head); the arrow's TIP is at the centre of its frame
local function makeArrow(parent, len, thick)
	local a = mk("Frame", {Name = "Arrow", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len * 2, len * 2), ZIndex = 7}, parent)
	local function bar(x, y, w, rot, color, z, tr)
		local b = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, thick),
			Rotation = rot, BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z}, a)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, b)
	end
	local head = len * 0.45
	local ang = math.rad(40)
	for _, layer in ipairs({{3, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 7, 0.6}, {0, WHITE, 8, 0}}) do -- soft shadow, then white
		local o, col, z, tr = layer[1], layer[2], layer[3], layer[4]
		bar(len - len * 0.45 + o, len + o, len * 0.9, 0, col, z, tr)
		bar(len - head / 2 * math.cos(ang) + o, len - head / 2 * math.sin(ang) + o, head, 40, col, z, tr)
		bar(len - head / 2 * math.cos(ang) + o, len + head / 2 * math.sin(ang) + o, head, -40, col, z, tr)
	end
	return a
end
local uiArrow = makeArrow(sg, 60, 12)
uiArrow.Visible = false

-- world arrow (floating over a place) + glowing trail from the player
local worldPart = mk("Part", {Name = "TutorialTarget", Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, Transparency = 1,
	Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)}, nil)
local worldAtt = mk("Attachment", {}, worldPart)
local bb = mk("BillboardGui", {Name = "WorldArrow", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 160), AlwaysOnTop = true, LightInfluence = 0,
	StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)}, worldPart)
local worldArrow = makeArrow(bb, 45, 11)
worldArrow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.75)
worldArrow.Rotation = 90 -- pointing down
local beam = mk("Beam", {FaceCamera = true, Width0 = 1.4, Width1 = 1.4, LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Segments = 20,
	Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(160, 230, 255)), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.35), Attachment1 = worldAtt, Enabled = false}, worldPart)

--------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
--------------------------------------------------
local target -- GuiObject the UI arrow points at
local worldOn = false
local t0 = 0

local function say(text)
	label.Text = text
	boxScale.Scale = 0.85
	tween(boxScale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end
local function pointAt(gui)
	target = gui
	uiArrow.Visible = gui ~= nil
end
local function pointWorld(pos)
	if pos then
		worldPart.Position = pos
		worldPart.Parent = workspace
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			local a0 = hrp:FindFirstChild("TutorialAtt") or mk("Attachment", {Name = "TutorialAtt", Position = Vector3.new(0, -2.5, 0)}, hrp)
			beam.Attachment0 = a0
			beam.Enabled = true
		end
		worldOn = true
	else
		worldPart.Parent = nil
		beam.Enabled = false
		worldOn = false
	end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not sg.Enabled then return end
	t0 += 1 / 60
	-- UI arrow glides next to its target and bounces toward it
	if target and target.Parent and target.Visible and target.AbsoluteSize.Magnitude > 0 then
		uiArrow.Visible = true
		local c = target.AbsolutePosition + target.AbsoluteSize / 2 + Vector2.new(0, game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y)
		local screen = camera.ViewportSize / 2
		local dir = (screen - c)
		dir = dir.Magnitude > 1 and dir.Unit or Vector2.new(0, -1)
		local r = math.max(target.AbsoluteSize.X, target.AbsoluteSize.Y) / 2 + 12
		local bounce = (math.sin(t0 * 6) + 1) * 7
		local tip = c + dir * (r + bounce)
		local goal = UDim2.fromOffset(tip.X, tip.Y)
		uiArrow.Position = uiArrow.Position:Lerp(goal, 0.25)
		uiArrow.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(-dir.Y, -dir.X))
	elseif target then
		uiArrow.Visible = false
	end
	if worldOn then
		worldArrow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.75, -math.abs(math.sin(t0 * 5)) * 18)
		beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3 + (math.sin(t0 * 4) + 1) * 0.15)
	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- STEPS
--------------------------------------------------
local running = false
local cancelled = false

local function waitUntil(fn)
	while not fn() do
		if cancelled then return false end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return not cancelled
end

local function finish()
	pointAt(nil)
	pointWorld(nil)
	tween(box, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(label, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
	task.wait(0.3)
	sg.Enabled = false
	box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	label.TextTransparency = 0
	running = false
	player:SetAttribute("TutorialDone", true)
	setSetting:FireServer("TutorialDone", true)
end

local function run()
	if running then return end
	running = true
	cancelled = false
	-- Wait for startup too: IntroPlaying is still nil while the avatar loads.
	local intro = player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("SnowIntro")
	if intro and intro.Enabled then
		if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroReady") == true end) then return end
	end
	if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") ~= true end) then return end
	task.wait(1)
	if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") ~= true end) then return end
	sg.Enabled = true

	local bottom = rngGui:WaitForChild("BottomBar")
	local rollB = bottom:WaitForChild("RollButton")
	local upB = bottom:WaitForChild("UpgradesButton")

	-- 1) roll
	say("Tap the dice to roll your first shovel!")
	pointAt(rollB)
	local rolled = false
	local conn = rngGui:WaitForChild("RollFinished").Event:Connect(function() rolled = true end)
	if not waitUntil(function() return rolled end) then conn:Disconnect() return end
	conn:Disconnect()

	-- 2) the spinner
	pointAt(nil)
	say("Nice! Your shovel spins around you ❄")
	task.wait(2.8)
	if cancelled then return end

	-- 3) dig in the snow field
	local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
	local field
	for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do if f.Id == "Starter" or f.Style == "Starter" then field = f break end end
	local snow = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Snow")
	local start = snow.Value
	local GOAL = 10
	if field then pointWorld(field.Center + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end
	local function progress() return math.clamp(snow.Value - start, 0, GOAL) end
	say("Walk into the snow to dig!  0/" .. GOAL .. " ❄")
	local c2 = snow.Changed:Connect(function()
		label.Text = "Walk into the snow to dig!  " .. progress() .. "/" .. GOAL .. " ❄"
	end)
	if not waitUntil(function() return progress() >= GOAL end) then c2:Disconnect() return end
	c2:Disconnect()
	pointWorld(nil)

	-- 4) upgrades
	say("Great! Spend snow on upgrades!")
	pointAt(upB)
	local tree = pg:WaitForChild("UpgradeTreeGui", 30)
	if not waitUntil(function() return tree and tree.Enabled end) then return end
	pointAt(nil)

	-- 5) done
	say("Roll rarer shovels and unlock new areas.\nHave fun!")
	task.wait(3.2)
	finish()
end

skip.Activated:Connect(function()
	cancelled = true
	finish()
end)

local function check()
	if player:GetAttribute("TutorialDone") == false and not running then task.spawn(run) end
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TutorialDone"):Connect(check)
check()

-- Light, local animation and interactions for Frostfall Village.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Prompts = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local village = workspace:WaitForChild("FrostfallVillage", 60)
if not village then return end
local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("RNGGui")
local openMenu = gui:WaitForChild("VillageOpenMenu")
local center = village:GetAttribute("Origin")
local movers = {}
for _,item in ipairs(village:GetDescendants()) do
 local motion = item:GetAttribute("VillageMotion")
 if motion then table.insert(movers, {item=item, motion=motion, base=item:IsA("Model") and item:GetPivot() or item.CFrame, phase=item:GetAttribute("Phase") or 0}) end
end
local effects = Instance.new("Folder")
effects.Name = "FrostfallLocalEffects"
effects.Parent = workspace
local toastGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
toastGui.Name = "FrostfallToast"
toastGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
toastGui.DisplayOrder = 25
toastGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui
local toast = Instance.new("TextLabel")
toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,0)
toast.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5,.13)
toast.Size = UDim2.new(.65,0,0,46)
toast.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toast.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245,252,255)
toast.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(29,55,83)
toast.TextStrokeTransparency = .1
toast.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
toast.TextScaled = true
toast.Visible = false
toast.Parent = toastGui
local textLimit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
textLimit.MaxTextSize = 30
textLimit.Parent = toast
local generation = 0
local function message(text)
 generation += 1
 local token = generation
 toast.Text = text; toast.TextTransparency = 0; toast.TextStrokeTransparency = .1; toast.Visible = true
 task.delay(2.1,function()
  if generation ~= token then return end
  TweenService:Create(toast,TweenInfo.new(.4),{TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1}):Play()
  task.delay(.4,function() if generation==token then toast.Visible=false end end)
 end)
end
local random = Random.new()
local function snowBurst(position)
 for i=1,26 do
  local flake = Instance.new("Part")
  flake.Name="CelebrationSnow";flake.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
  local size=random:NextNumber(.18,.48);flake.Size=Vector3.one*size
  flake.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
  flake.Color=i%4==0 and Color3.fromRGB(255,205,92) or Color3.fromRGB(217,247,255)
  flake.Anchored=true;flake.CanCollide=false;flake.CanTouch=false;flake.CanQuery=false
  flake.Position=position;flake.Parent=effects
  local a=i*math.pi*2/26
  local reach=random:NextNumber(3,9)
  TweenService:Create(flake,TweenInfo.new(random:NextNumber(.8,1.5),Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*reach,random:NextNumber(1,7),math.sin(a)*reach),Transparency=1,Size=Vector3.one*.06}):Play()
  Debris:AddItem(flake,1.6)
 end
end
local last = {}
local shakeUntil = 0
Prompts.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, who)
 if who ~= player or not prompt:IsDescendantOf(village) or player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then return end
 local anchor=prompt.Parent
 local action=anchor:GetAttribute("VillageAction")
 if not action then return end
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root or (root.Position-anchor.Position).Magnitude>prompt.MaxActivationDistance+3 then return end
 if action=="Upgrades" or action=="Pets" or action=="Shop" or action=="Rebirth" then
  openMenu:Fire(action)
 elseif action=="Globe" or action=="Celebrate" then
  local now=os.clock()
  if now-(last[action] or -math.huge)<4 then return end
  last[action]=now
  if action=="Globe" then
   shakeUntil=now+2
   snowBurst(village.Snowglobe.GlassDome.Position)
   message("A little winter magic!")
  else
   snowBurst(anchor:GetAttribute("EffectPosition") or anchor.Position)
   message("Frost Hop complete! Nice jumping!")
  end
 end
end)
local elapsed=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<1/30 then return end;elapsed=0
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root or (root.Position-center).Magnitude>180 then return end
 local t=os.clock()
 for _,v in ipairs(movers) do
  if v.item.Parent then
   if v.motion=="Spin" then
    v.item:PivotTo(v.base*CFrame.Angles(0,t*.3,0))
   elseif v.motion=="Snow" then
    local speed=t<shakeUntil and 8 or 1.4
    v.item.CFrame=v.base+Vector3.new(math.sin(t*speed+v.phase)*.35,math.sin(t*speed+v.phase)*.75,math.cos(t*speed+v.phase)*.35)
   elseif v.motion=="Smoke" then
    local rise=(t*.3+v.phase*.22)%1
    v.item.CFrame=v.base+Vector3.new(math.sin(t+v.phase)*.3,rise*1.7,0)
    v.item.Transparency=.5+rise*.5
   elseif v.motion=="Crystal" then
    v.item.CFrame=CFrame.new(v.base.Position+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(t*1.6)*.4,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,t*.5,0)*v.base.Rotation
   end
  end
 end
end)

-- One intro per join. The server owns placement and always releases the character.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local SF=require(RS:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local remote=RS:WaitForChild("SnowIntroRequest")
local active,seen={},{}
local function finish(p,reason)
 local s=active[p]; if not s then return end
 active[p]=nil
 if s.root.Parent then
  s.root.Anchored=s.anchored
  s.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  s.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 end
 if s.hum.Parent then s.hum.AutoRotate=s.autoRotate end
 if s.died then s.died:Disconnect() end
 p:SetAttribute("IntroActive",false)
 p:SetAttribute("IntroFinished",reason or "complete")
end
remote.OnServerInvoke=function(p,action)
 if action=="Finish" then finish(p,"complete");return true end
 if action=="Skip" then finish(p,"skipped");return true end
 if action~="Begin" and action~="Preview" then return nil end
 if action=="Preview" and not RunService:IsStudio() then return nil end
 if active[p] or (seen[p] and action~="Preview") then return nil end
 local char=p.Character
 local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or root.Anchored then return nil end
 local field
 for _,f in ipairs(SF.Fields)do if f.Style=="Starter" then field=f;break end end
 if not field then return nil end
 local phase=RS.SnowStages.Starter:FindFirstChild("Phase3")
 local x=field.Center.X-field.Width*SF.TileSize/2-6
 local query=RaycastParams.new();query.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;query.FilterDescendantsInstances={char};query.RespectCanCollide=true
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,field.Center.Y+35,field.Center.Z),Vector3.new(0,-90,0),query)
 local surface=hit and hit.Position.Y or field.Center.Y
 local origin=CFrame.new(x,surface,field.Center.Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,-math.pi/2,0)
 local foot=char:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot") or char:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
 local height=foot and root.Position.Y-(foot.Position.Y-foot.Size.Y/2) or hum.HipHeight+root.Size.Y/2
 height=math.clamp(height,2,5)
 local final=origin*CFrame.new(3,height,0)
 local s={root=root,hum=hum,anchored=root.Anchored,autoRotate=hum.AutoRotate}
 active[p]=s;seen[p]=true
 p:SetAttribute("IntroActive",true);p:SetAttribute("IntroFinished",nil)
 root.Anchored=true;hum.AutoRotate=false
 root.CFrame=final;root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 s.died=hum.Died:Connect(function()finish(p,"interrupted")end)
 task.delay(action=="Preview" and 60 or 15,function()if active[p]==s then finish(p,"timeout")end end)
 return {Origin=origin,Height=height,Final=final,Duration=7}
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)finish(p,"left");seen[p]=nil end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
 p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()finish(p,"respawn")end)
end)

-- Two-way access to the additive lobby. No inventory or currency changes.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Prompts = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local village = workspace:WaitForChild("FrostfallVillage")
local gate = workspace:WaitForChild("FrostfallVillageGate")
local cooldown = {}
local targets = {Village = village.Arrival.Value, Main = village.MainArrival.Value, Field = village.FieldArrival.Value}

Prompts.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, player)
 if prompt.Name ~= "VillagePrompt" then return end
 if not (prompt:IsDescendantOf(village) or prompt:IsDescendantOf(gate)) then return end
 local anchor = prompt.Parent
 local target = targets[anchor:GetAttribute("VillageTravel")]
 if not target or not anchor:IsA("BasePart") then return end
 local character = player.Character
 local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
 if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then return end
 if (root.Position - anchor.Position).Magnitude > prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 3 then return end
 local now = os.clock()
 if now - (cooldown[player] or -math.huge) < 1.5 then return end
 cooldown[player] = now
 -- Request the destination before moving, with a bounded streaming wait.
 pcall(function() player:RequestStreamAroundAsync(target.Position, 2) end)
 if player.Character ~= character or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
 character:PivotTo(target)
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
 root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) cooldown[player] = nil end)
